functions.name: addRedPanda
functions.description: Adds a Redpanda container resource to the application. Redpanda is a Kafka API compatible streaming platform, so the resource can be referenced by any Kafka client integration.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the container image.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name is used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The host port that the Kafka API is exposed on. If `null` a random port is assigned.

functions.name: adminEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the Admin API HTTP endpoint for the Redpanda broker.

functions.name: connectionStringExpression
functions.description: Gets the connection string expression for the Redpanda broker in the form of `host:port`, suitable for use as the Kafka bootstrap servers value.

functions.name: host
functions.description: Gets the host of the primary Kafka endpoint.

functions.name: internalEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the internal Kafka API endpoint used for container-to-container communication.

functions.name: port
functions.description: Gets the port of the primary Kafka endpoint.

functions.name: primaryEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the primary (Kafka API) endpoint for the Redpanda broker. This endpoint is reachable from the host.
functions.remarks:
The endpoint is pinned to the localhost network so that it always resolves to the published host
address, even when the expression is evaluated for the Redpanda container itself (which otherwise
resolves endpoints over the container network and would yield the container's own broker port).

functions.name: schemaRegistryEndpoint
functions.description: Gets the Schema Registry HTTP endpoint for the Redpanda broker.

functions.name: withConsole
functions.description: Adds a Redpanda Console container to the application, configured to connect to the Redpanda broker.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the container image.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for the Redpanda server resource.
functions.signature: withConsole(configureContainer?: (obj: RedPandaConsoleContainerResource) => Promise<void>, containerName?: string): RedPandaServerResource

parameters.name: configureContainer
parameters.description: An optional callback to configure the Redpanda Console container resource.

parameters.name: containerName
parameters.description: The name of the container (optional).

functions.name: withDataBindMount
functions.description: Adds a bind mount for the data folder to a Redpanda container resource.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source directory on the host to mount into the container.

parameters.name: isReadOnly
parameters.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only mount.

functions.name: withDataVolume
functions.description: Adds a named volume for the data folder to a Redpanda container resource.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the volume. Defaults to an auto-generated name based on the application and resource names.

parameters.name: isReadOnly
parameters.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only volume.

functions.name: withHostPort
functions.description: Configures the host port that the Redpanda Console resource is exposed on instead of using a randomly assigned port.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to bind on the host. If `null` a random port is assigned.

functions.name: withKafkaUI
functions.description: Adds a Kafka UI container to the application, configured to connect to the Redpanda broker. This is the same Kafka management UI (the `kafbat/kafka-ui` image) used by the official Aspire Kafka integration, so it works against any Kafka API compatible broker.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the container image.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for the Redpanda server resource.
functions.signature: withKafkaUI(configureContainer?: (obj: RedPandaKafkaUiContainerResource) => Promise<void>, containerName?: string): RedPandaServerResource

parameters.name: configureContainer
parameters.description: An optional callback to configure the Kafka UI container resource.

parameters.name: containerName
parameters.description: The name of the container (optional).

handleTypes.name: RedPandaConsoleContainerResource
handleTypes.description: A resource that represents a Redpanda Console container, a web UI for managing and inspecting one or more Redpanda (or Kafka) brokers.

capabilities.name: withHostPort

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to bind on the host. If `null` a random port is assigned.

handleTypes.name: RedPandaKafkaUiContainerResource
handleTypes.description: A resource that represents a Kafka UI container (the `kafbat/kafka-ui` image), a web UI for managing and inspecting one or more Kafka API compatible brokers such as Redpanda.

handleTypes.name: RedPandaServerResource
handleTypes.description: A resource that represents a Redpanda streaming platform container.
handleTypes.remarks:
Redpanda is a Kafka API compatible streaming platform. The `ConnectionStringExpression`
returns the bootstrap broker address (`host:port`) that Kafka clients use to connect.
